pattern_description: Multi-card syndicate operating through shared device profile (Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050) across 8 distinct cards and 8 customers, operating behind an anonymous proxy and linked to 64 prior closed fraud cases.
sar_narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-015
Subject Customer: C03042 | Subject Card: C03042-K1
Activity Period: 2016-11-17 19:03:36 | Cumulative Exposure: $599.94
Primary Typology: UNDOCUMENTED

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
Financial institution automated graph surveillance identified organized anomalous activity involving customer C03042 and card C03042-K1, resulting in cumulative suspicious exposure of $599.94 across transaction(s) 3464869.

2. GRAPH & DEVICE TOPOLOGY ANALYSIS:
Graph traversal revealed that transaction 3464869 originated from device profile 'Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050' (Device ID: DEV_884ff18a5b80). Graph topological queries confirmed this exact device profile is shared across 8 distinct cardholder accounts and is connected to 64 previously confirmed fraud case(s) (CC-0283, CC-1690, CC-0006, CC-2193). Activity exhibited proxy masking characteristics (Proxy status: ).

3. POLICY COMPLIANCE & ACTIONS TAKEN:
In accordance with Fraud Policy v1.0 (Rules R6, R8, R9), the institution initiated immediate defensive card blocks, escalated the case to Senior Fraud Management (Level 2 Approval), and filed this formal FinCEN SAR.

evidence.claim: Device profile (Trident/7.0 | Windows 8.1 | ie 11.0 for desktop | 1680x1050) is shared across 8 cards and 8 distinct customers, linked to 64 historical fraud cases (CC-0283, CC-1690, CC-0006)

containment_steps: Immediate hard block on primary compromised card C03042-K1
Identify and freeze all companion cards sharing device profile across graph
Add device hardware fingerprint and proxy IP ranges to real-time blacklists
Revoke active web/mobile banking sessions for affected accounts

customer_communication.message_copy: Dear Cardholder, we detected unauthorized activity on your card ending in 2-K1. For your security, we have placed a hold on the card. A fraud specialist will contact you to reissue a new card.

financial_remediation: Issue provisional credit to affected cardholder(s)
Waive all associated late fees or overdraft charges
compliance_actions: File FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) under Rule R9 (Organized Proxy Syndicate)
Escalate case dossier to Senior Fraud Operations & Legal Compliance (Level 2 Approval)
Write finalized investigation dossier and syndicate links back to TigerGraph
